entities.name: Fixed tariff of Rs. 2.42/kWh plus trading margin of Rs. 0.07/kWh for the entire term of this agreement.
Benefits on account of any reduction in tariff as per provisions of SECI-SPD PPA, shall be passed on to the Buying Entity.

In cases of early part-commissioning, till the achievement of full commissioning or SCD, whichever is earlier, the Buying Entity shall purchase the generation till SCD, at 75% of the tariff as mentioned in the Article 5.1.1 plus Trading Margin of Rs 0.07/kWh.
In case of full commissioning of the Project(s) prior to SCD, Buying Entity shall purchase the power at tariff as per article 5.1.1 plus Trading Margin of Rs 0.07/kWh.
